items.zh: 兼容部分 AMD 老显卡——视频录制初始化失败时自动切换软件编码，不再整体失效
items.en: Compatibility fix for some older AMD GPUs — recording now falls back to software encoding instead of failing entirely

items.zh: 修复训练途中调整窗口大小后，之后所有对局都无法分析的问题
items.en: Fixed all later runs failing to analyze after resizing the game window mid-session

items.zh: 修复 Steam 正在更新 KovaaK 时启动本软件，导致对局记录丢失的问题
items.en: Fixed run tracking going silent when the app starts while Steam is updating KovaaK

items.zh: 自定义数据存储位置——录像与遥测可一键迁到非系统盘，C 盘不再被占满
items.en: Custom data location — move recordings and telemetry off your system drive

items.zh: 用户中心新增「调用记录」——每次 AI 调用的时间、模型与 token 用量一目了然
items.en: Usage records in Account Center — time, model and tokens for every AI call

items.zh: 长对话记忆修复——历史不丢、上下文更连贯、回复更省额度
items.en: Long-conversation memory fix — full history retained with cache-backed replies

items.zh: 修复新对话快速连发消息被拆散到多个会话的问题
items.en: Fixed rapid-fire messages in a new chat being split across sessions

items.zh: 修复连通测试误报「登录凭证已失效」的问题
items.en: Fixed connection test falsely reporting expired credentials

items.zh: 顶栏讨论条防遮挡三键
items.en: Top-bar discussion chips no longer overlap the three window buttons

items.zh: 安装与更新流程稳定性
items.en: More stable install and update flow

items.zh: 官方场景库搜索（17.5 万场景模糊匹配）
items.en: Official scenario library search (fuzzy match across 175k scenarios)
